scripts.db:types: f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; npx supabase gen types typescript --local 2>/dev/null > "$f" && grep -v '^Connecting to' "$f" | grep -v '^A new version' | grep -v '^We recommend' | npx prettier --no-config --parser typescript --no-semi > src/lib/types/database.gen.ts; s=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $s
scripts.db:types:linked: f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; npx supabase gen types typescript --linked 2>/dev/null > "$f" && grep -v '^Connecting to' "$f" | grep -v '^A new version' | grep -v '^We recommend' | npx prettier --no-config --parser typescript --no-semi > src/lib/types/database.gen.ts; s=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $s
scripts.db:types:check: f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; if ! npx supabase gen types typescript --local 2>/dev/null > "$f"; then rm -f "$f"; echo 'db:types:check: supabase not running — skipping'; exit 0; fi; grep -v '^Connecting to' "$f" | grep -v '^A new version' | grep -v '^We recommend' | npx prettier --no-config --parser typescript --no-semi > "$f.ts"; if diff "$f.ts" src/lib/types/database.gen.ts; then rm -f "$f" "$f.ts"; else rm -f "$f" "$f.ts"; echo 'database.gen.ts is out of date — run npm run db:types'; exit 1; fi
